# Commands dashboard reliability: Phabricator loading and automatic build status

`withConsoleBuildJobs()` must preserve automatic phases `cancelled` and `interrupted` rather than collapsing every non-success result to `failed`. `command-sessions.js` renders `Build: cancelled`/`Build: interrupted` with warning styling; error styling is only for actual failure. [Task 2]

Scope: console.
